I’ve ordered from this shop online many times, and I just wanted to say that they’re genuinely amazing.

The products have always been great, but what really keeps me coming back is the customer service. The admin is always kind, professional, and incredibly helpful. We’ve always communicated in English (I’m not even sure if they’re Thai), and every interaction has been smooth and pleasant.

I just want the team to know that your customer service is a big reason why I keep buying from you. Great service really does make a difference. Thank you for always being so helpful, and keep up the great work!

What a wonderful place! A cute girl met us and showed us a cool menu right on her MacBook. There's a wide selection of plants and a cozy atmosphere in the room.

The girl rolled a great joint and made us some tea—thank you so much for such attention and a warm welcome. A great place that I recommend to everyone. Previously, I had to drive 10 minutes to another store, but now this wonderful place was just around the corner!

The plants are delicious, of various colors, and the shoots clearly contain oils. I've been thinking all day about tea, which I haven't had in a long time—and lo and behold, it's here!
